newsitem.title: UK: UK shares close off lows as Wall Street firms.
newsitem.headline: UK shares close off lows as Wall Street firms.

text.p: A firm early showing on Wall Street helped pull UK shares off their earlier lows by the close of business on Tuesday, after a jittery day dogged by worries over rising UK interest rates and next month's budget.
The FTSE 100 index closed 5.0 points lower at 4,557.8, its fifth straight decline and its lowest close in four weeks, with decliners in a three-to-two majority.

An early rise in the Dow, up some 30 points as London closed, coupled with a rebound in leading bank stocks, helped drag the FTSE 100 off an initial near-40 point tumble. Sharp gains in gilts and German bunds also lent support.
